subject: Error-bar half-widths in Katsounaros thesis Diag 12.3 (thesis copy of Katsounaros et al. 2012 Fig. 1), claimed uniform +-10.0% (18 resolved bars 0.0997 +- 0.0010)
summary: I re-measured 13 bars (14 including a low-confidence one) on the page image with my own axis calibration and my own cap reads. Relative half-width: 0.0997 +- 0.0007 (range 0.0982-0.1009); the 11 bars with half-width >= 5 px give 0.0996 +- 0.0007. That reproduces the analyst's 0.0997 +- 0.0010. Cap rows agree with the analyst's to within 0.04 px on 24 of 28 caps; the three N2O lower caps (between the star's legs) read 0.22-0.24 px higher, and the NO3 90-min upper cap, which is drawn over the NO2 circle arc, differs by 0.08 px. Bar centres agree within 0.05 mM. The bars are a uniform 10% of the plotted value, not per-point statistics. Their type (1 sigma, 2 sigma, range) is not stated in the thesis, which the dataset already flags. The NH3 120-min cap midpoint (25.8-25.9 mM) is confirmed for the thesis copy; it does not settle what the journal figure shows (see the intermediates verification).
method: Own scripts in literature/extraction_scripts/k12_verify/ (v5_calib.py, v5_bars.py, v5_final.py); the analyst's literature/extraction_scripts/k12_hidden/errorbars/ scripts were not read or run. Page image p221.jpg (300 dpi, 2481 x 3509 px, session scratch, not retained), read with python -I. Calibration: y-axis line at col 691.9 and x-axis line at row 2837.0 located by dark-pixel counts. 10 y ticks (500-50 mM) located by darkness centroids left of the axis, plus 0 mM at the x-axis line: 0.598168 mM/px, offset 1696.892, max residual 0.124 mM. 7 x ticks below the axis: 0.149818 min/px, max residual 0.041 min. This agrees with the analyst's 0.598089 mM/px to 0.013%. Caps: v5_bars.py lists candidate rows that are dark on both sides of the stem (columns stem-8..-3 and stem+3..+8) in a wide window, not centred on the 10% expectation, and writes zoomed crops. The cap rows used were then chosen from pixel dumps, and each cap's row is the darkness-weighted centroid over its own rows (v5_final.py; narrower columns inside open triangles, left columns only where a model curve crosses).

checks.name: claim5_relative_half_widths
checks.detail: Rel. half-width (verifier / analyst): NO3 30 min 0.0998/0.0998; NO2 30 0.1003/0.1003; N2 60 0.0989/0.0987; N2 90 0.0999/0.0999; N2 120 0.1003/0.1003; N2 150 0.0998/0.0998; N2 180 0.0998/0.0998; N2O 120 0.0989/0.1003; N2O 150 0.1000/0.1013; N2O 180 0.0982/0.0994; NO3 60 0.0999/0.0999 (upper cap inside the open NO2 circle); NH3 180 0.0993/0.0994; NH3 90 0.1009/0.1008 (2.5 px half-width). Low confidence, not in the summary: NO3 90 0.0997/0.1001. Summary of the 13: mean 0.0997, sd 0.0007, min 0.0982, max 0.1009. Bars span 15-309 mM, so per-point replicate statistics would scatter far more than +-0.0007; a fixed 10% is the only consistent reading.

checks.name: NH3_120_thesis_copy
checks.detail: Lower cap at row 2798.0 (23.22 mM; a model curve runs at row 2799). The upper cap shares a 4-row grey band (rows 2789-2792) with the NO3 lower cap; assigning it to row 2789.0 or 2789.5 gives a bar midpoint of 25.91 or 25.76 mM (analyst 25.78). Independent of the cap assignment: the clean 180-min triangle has its bar midpoint 8.18 px above its base stroke, and the same offset from the 120-min base stroke (row 2801.68) gives 25.91 mM. Daniel's 19.60 maps to row 2804.05, 2.4 px below that base stroke (which itself is at 21.01 mM), on the error-bar stem. This establishes the thesis-copy value only. The journal figure Daniel digitized was not available, and the thesis's own Diag 12.1 NH3 rates imply 20.8 mM at 120 min (see ../katsounaros2009thesis_diag12p1_intermediates/verification.json).

claims_tested.claim: every measurable bar is +-10% of the plotted value; 18 resolved bars 0.0997 +- 0.0010
cap midpoint puts NH3 at 120 min at 25.8 mM
claims_tested.result: confirmed (25.76-25.91 mM) for the thesis copy

issues: No value errors found. N2O lower caps: the analyst's rows are 0.22-0.24 px lower, which makes the half-width larger by 0.0003-0.0014 relative (about 0.07 mM). That is within the analyst's stated half-width reading sd for these bars (0.127 mM) and comes from star-leg contamination. Not material.

The README byproduct sentence 'NH3 at 120 min from the caps (25.8 mM) supports the thesis marker over Daniel's 19.6' is true of the thesis copy only. It should not be used to overrule Daniel's journal-figure reading, because the thesis Diag 12.1 NH3 rates point to about 20.8 mM. The meta already cross-references the integration note; the README could say so in the same sentence.

Carried flag: the bar type is unstated. relative_sigma = 0.10 is an upper-end 1-sigma choice; if the bars are 2 sigma or a max-error range, the 1-sigma value is about 0.05. The 10% matches the thesis's 'experimental error of the order of 10%' (printed p. 81, a different run).
scripts: literature/extraction_scripts/k12_verify/: v5_calib.py <p221.jpg> <out.json> (axes, raw ticks); v5_bars.py <p221.jpg> v5_bars_raw.json <cropdir> (calibration and cap candidates; crops stay in scratch because they contain the thesis page); v5_final.py <repo> <p221.jpg> v5_bars_raw.json v5_final_out.json (final caps, summary, comparison with the analyst). Run with python -I.
